action.formula: At each eligible completed minute use current parent after-open quantities/cash marked at completed close. Let d=min(0.025,current SOXL weight,max(0,(cash weight-0.15)/2),max(0,(1-SOXX weight)/3)). Target weights=(SOXL-d,SOXX+3d,cash-2d), conserving 3xSOXL+SOXX nominal beta at decision time. If d<=0 or whole-share SOXL sell and SOXX buy do not both occur, mark unknown. Size target at decision using only completed bar; simulate actual whole-share fill at next subsequent bar open. Do not raise original beta cap or invoke protective stop.
